summary: The rendered output captures the general layout and many fields, but it has several major data and completeness issues: the top-right identifiers are incomplete and the certificate number is wrong, a source certification/signature mark in the table is missing, the print date is mislabeled as A.D., and at least one address/plot value appears incorrect.
matches_well: Overall logical structure is recognizable: government header, title, photograph/thumb placeholders, owner information box, parcel table, total area, and footer signatures are present.
Photograph, coat of arms, and thumb impressions are represented with bordered placeholders in approximately the correct left-side positions.
Most owner identity fields such as landowner name, citizenship number, issue date, and issued office appear to be captured.
The parcel table generally preserves the source’s column structure and the three main land entries.
Total area is rendered as 4332.09 sq.m., matching the visible total in the source.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows two identifiers: “जग्गाधनी संकेत नम्बर” with value “PF002728503” and “प्रमाणपत्र नम्बर” with value “NMO000091”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Only one field is shown: “Land Ownership Certificate No.: NM0000095”/similar.
The certificate number is rendered as “NM0000095”/similar.

discrepancies.location: owner address / V.D.C.-M.C. field and table district/VDC column
discrepancies.source_observation: The source appears to show “नाङ्लेभारे” for the V.D.C./M.C. name.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The place name is rendered as “नाईलभौरे”/similar.

discrepancies.location: main land parcel table, third entry, prior plot number
discrepancies.source_observation: The source appears to show the third prior plot number as “६९२”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The third prior plot number is rendered as “६१२”.

discrepancies.location: right side of parcel table, certifier/signature area
discrepancies.source_observation: The source contains a large red handwritten/signature or certification mark in this area, which should be represented by a placeholder such as “Signed/Certified”.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: The “Signature of the certifier” column is blank.

discrepancies.source_observation: The source shows “प्रिन्ट मिति २०८२/०४/१४” without “A.D.”; adding “A.D.” changes the calendar meaning.
The source names “भूमि व्यवस्था, सहकारी तथा गरिबी निवारण मन्त्रालय” and “भूमि व्यवस्थापन तथा अभिलेख विभाग”; the rendered English institutional names are not faithful translations.
discrepancies.rendered_observation: Rendered as “Ministry of Land Reform and Management” and “Department of Land Reform and Management”.
